target.rawSql:
-- one region per failure: FAILURE -> return to service (a point while the engine is still down)
SELECT
    failed_at AS time,
    coalesce(returned_to_service_at, failed_at) AS timeEnd,
    concat(engine_id, ' failed in lifecycle ', toString(lifecycle_id), ' at cycle ', toString(failure_cycle), ': ',
           failure_mode,
           if(isNull(repair_seconds), ' (still out of service)',
              concat(' (back in service after ', toString(round(repair_seconds, 1)), ' s)'))) AS text,
    concat(engine_id, ',', failure_mode) AS tags
FROM fct_engine_failures FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(failed_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 1000

description: Maintenance-engineering board of the fleet: availability, failures, MTBF and MTTR per engine and per day, time in each status, the failure-mode Pareto and the SCD2 status timeline built from the CDC history of the engine registry.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Share of the selected engines' time in the range spent in service (HEALTHY, WARNING or CRITICAL) rather than in FAILURE (under repair) or MAINTENANCE_RESET (repaired, not flown yet). Every interval of the SCD2 status history (int_engine_status_history) is clipped to the range; the open interval counts up to now.

targets.rawSql:
-- time in service / time observed of the selected engines in the range
SELECT if(sum(seconds) > 0, sumIf(seconds, is_available = 1) / sum(seconds), NULL) AS availability
FROM
(
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        operational_status,
        is_available,
        (toUnixTimestamp64Micro(least(coalesce(valid_to, now64(6, 'UTC')), toDateTime64($__toTime, 6, 'UTC')))
            - toUnixTimestamp64Micro(greatest(valid_from, toDateTime64($__fromTime, 6, 'UTC')))) / 1e6 AS seconds
    FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
    WHERE valid_from < $__toTime
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > $__fromTime)
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
)
WHERE seconds > 0

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Failures of the selected engines that began in the range (fct_engine_failures: one per entry into FAILURE, i.e. per unscheduled removal).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS failures
FROM fct_engine_failures FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(failed_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: MTBF
panels.description: Mean time between failures of the failures in the range: wall-clock time in service from the previous return to service (or registration) to the failure, and the cycles flown in it (fct_engine_failures.operating_seconds / operating_cycles; failures whose operating run began before the CDC history are left out). While the platform is stopped every engine keeps its last status, so a lifecycle that spans a stop inflates the time; the cycles are not affected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    avg(operating_seconds) AS `In service`,
    avg(operating_cycles) AS `Cycles`
FROM fct_engine_failures FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(failed_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: MTTR
panels.description: Mean time to repair of the failures in the range that have returned to service: from the FAILURE to the first pulse of the next lifecycle (repair plus reset; fct_engine_failures.repair_seconds). The simulator repairs in SIM_MAINTENANCE_SECONDS (20 s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(repair_seconds) AS mttr
FROM fct_engine_failures FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(failed_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: Out of service now
panels.description: Selected engines whose current status interval (int_engine_status_history.is_current) is FAILURE or MAINTENANCE_RESET.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(is_available = 0) AS out_of_service
FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
WHERE is_current = 1
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)

panels.title: Downtime
panels.description: Engine-time of the selected engines in the range spent out of service (FAILURE + MAINTENANCE_RESET intervals of the SCD2 status history, clipped to the range).

targets.rawSql:
-- engine-time out of service (FAILURE, MAINTENANCE_RESET) of the selected engines in the range
SELECT sumIf(seconds, is_available = 0) AS downtime
FROM
(
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        operational_status,
        is_available,
        (toUnixTimestamp64Micro(least(coalesce(valid_to, now64(6, 'UTC')), toDateTime64($__toTime, 6, 'UTC')))
            - toUnixTimestamp64Micro(greatest(valid_from, toDateTime64($__fromTime, 6, 'UTC')))) / 1e6 AS seconds
    FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
    WHERE valid_from < $__toTime
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > $__fromTime)
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
)
WHERE seconds > 0

panels.title: Availability, failures and repair time per UTC day (gold rpt_fleet_reliability_daily)
Availability per day
panels.description: Daily availability (time in service / time observed) of every selected engine and of the whole fleet (engine-seconds of all engines). The newest day is partial, up to the status history's horizon. A day the platform was stopped counts in each engine's last status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, engine_id, availability
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id != 'ALL'
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, availability AS Fleet
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id = 'ALL'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failures per day
panels.description: Failures per UTC day and engine (rpt_fleet_reliability_daily.failures, counted on the day the engine failed), stacked.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, engine_id, failures
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id != 'ALL'
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: MTBF per day (fleet)
panels.description: Fleet-wide mean time between failures of the failures of each UTC day: wall-clock time in service since the previous return to service (left) and the cycles flown (right). Independent of the engine filter. A lifecycle that spans a stop of the platform inflates the time, never the cycles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time,
    mtbf_seconds AS `MTBF (in service)`,
    mtbf_cycles AS `MTBF (cycles)`
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id = 'ALL'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: MTTR per day
panels.description: Mean time to repair of each UTC day's repaired failures, per selected engine and for the fleet: from the FAILURE to the first pulse of the next lifecycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, engine_id, mttr_seconds
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id != 'ALL'
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY time

SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, mttr_seconds AS Fleet
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id = 'ALL'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Time in status per day
panels.description: Share of the selected engines' time per UTC day in each registry status (rpt_fleet_reliability_daily; hours in the tooltip). HEALTHY, WARNING and CRITICAL are in service; FAILURE is the repair, MAINTENANCE the reset into the next lifecycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time,
    sum(healthy_seconds) / 3600 AS HEALTHY,
    sum(warning_seconds) / 3600 AS WARNING,
    sum(critical_seconds) / 3600 AS CRITICAL,
    sum(failure_seconds) / 3600 AS FAILURE,
    sum(maintenance_reset_seconds) / 3600 AS MAINTENANCE
FROM rpt_fleet_reliability_daily FINAL
WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime)
  AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND engine_id != 'ALL'
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engines in the selected range (int_engine_status_history, fct_engine_failures)
Reliability by engine
panels.description: Per selected engine over the range: current status, availability (time in service / time observed), failures that began in the range with their MTBF (time in service and cycles since the previous return to service) and MTTR, and the time in each status (SCD2 intervals clipped to the range). Sorted by availability. Click an engine for its fleet health board.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    t.engine_id AS `Engine`,
    c.status AS `Status now`,
    t.available / t.observed AS `Availability`,
    f.failures AS `Failures`,
    f.mtbf_seconds AS `MTBF`,
    f.mtbf_cycles AS `MTBF (cycles)`,
    f.mttr_seconds AS `MTTR`,
    t.healthy AS `Healthy`,
    t.warning AS `Warning`,
    t.critical AS `Critical`,
    t.failure AS `In repair`,
    t.maintenance_reset AS `Reset`
FROM
(
    -- time per status in the range, every interval clipped to it
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        sum(seconds) AS observed,
        sumIf(seconds, is_available = 1) AS available,
        sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'HEALTHY') AS healthy,
        sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'WARNING') AS warning,
        sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'CRITICAL') AS critical,
        sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'FAILURE') AS failure,
        sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'MAINTENANCE_RESET') AS maintenance_reset
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            engine_id,
            operational_status,
            is_available,
            (toUnixTimestamp64Micro(least(coalesce(valid_to, now64(6, 'UTC')), toDateTime64($__toTime, 6, 'UTC')))
                - toUnixTimestamp64Micro(greatest(valid_from, toDateTime64($__fromTime, 6, 'UTC')))) / 1e6 AS seconds
        FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
        WHERE valid_from < $__toTime
          AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > $__fromTime)
          AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
    )
    WHERE seconds > 0
    GROUP BY engine_id
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    -- failures in the range; averages of an empty set read NULL
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        count() AS failures,
        avg(operating_seconds) AS mtbf_seconds,
        avg(operating_cycles) AS mtbf_cycles,
        avg(repair_seconds) AS mttr_seconds
    FROM fct_engine_failures FINAL
    WHERE $__timeFilter(failed_at)
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
    GROUP BY engine_id
) AS f ON f.engine_id = t.engine_id
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT engine_id, toNullable(toString(operational_status)) AS status
    FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
    WHERE is_current = 1
) AS c ON c.engine_id = t.engine_id
ORDER BY `Availability`, `Engine`

panels.title: Time in status by engine
panels.description: Share of each selected engine's time in the range per registry status (SCD2 intervals clipped to the range; hours in the tooltip).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    engine_id AS engine,
    sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'HEALTHY') / 3600 AS HEALTHY,
    sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'WARNING') / 3600 AS WARNING,
    sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'CRITICAL') / 3600 AS CRITICAL,
    sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'FAILURE') / 3600 AS FAILURE,
    sumIf(seconds, operational_status = 'MAINTENANCE_RESET') / 3600 AS MAINTENANCE
FROM
(
    SELECT
        engine_id,
        operational_status,
        is_available,
        (toUnixTimestamp64Micro(least(coalesce(valid_to, now64(6, 'UTC')), toDateTime64($__toTime, 6, 'UTC')))
            - toUnixTimestamp64Micro(greatest(valid_from, toDateTime64($__fromTime, 6, 'UTC')))) / 1e6 AS seconds
    FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
    WHERE valid_from < $__toTime
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > $__fromTime)
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
)
WHERE seconds > 0
GROUP BY engine
ORDER BY engine

panels.title: Status timeline
panels.description: The SCD2 status history of every selected engine (int_engine_status_history: one row per status interval, built from the CDC change log of engine_status_registry): HEALTHY -> WARNING -> CRITICAL -> FAILURE -> MAINTENANCE -> HEALTHY. FAILURE is the repair (about 20 s), MAINTENANCE the reset until the first pulse of the next lifecycle; zoom in to see them. Grey: deregistered.

targets.rawSql:
-- every SCD2 interval that overlaps the range, starting at the later of its valid_from and the range
-- start; a deregistration (closed_by_delete) leaves a gap until the engine is registered again
SELECT time, engine_id, status_code
FROM
(
    SELECT
        greatest(valid_from, toDateTime64($__fromTime, 6, 'UTC')) AS time,
        engine_id,
        transform(toString(operational_status), ['HEALTHY', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL', 'FAILURE', 'MAINTENANCE_RESET'], [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], 5) AS status_code
    FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
    WHERE valid_from <= $__toTime
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > $__fromTime)
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT assumeNotNull(valid_to) AS time, engine_id, 5 AS status_code
    FROM int_engine_status_history FINAL
    WHERE closed_by_delete = 1
      AND valid_to > $__fromTime
      AND valid_to <= $__toTime
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failure-mode Pareto
panels.description: All recorded maintenance work orders of the selected engines by failure mode (gold rpt_failure_mode_pareto, not limited to the time range), most frequent first, with the cumulative share on the right axis: the few modes behind most removals are the shop's priority.

targets.rawSql:
-- the Pareto of the selected engines: their rows of rpt_failure_mode_pareto summed per mode
-- (with every engine selected, the fleet row engine_id = 'ALL')
SELECT
    failure_mode,
    work_orders AS `Failures`,
    sum(work_orders) OVER (ORDER BY work_orders DESC, failure_mode ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
        / sum(work_orders) OVER () AS `Cumulative share`
FROM
(
    SELECT failure_mode, sum(work_orders) AS work_orders
    FROM rpt_failure_mode_pareto FINAL
    WHERE engine_id != 'ALL'
      AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
    GROUP BY failure_mode
)
ORDER BY `Failures` DESC, failure_mode

panels.title: Failures and repairs
panels.description: Every failure of the selected engines that began in the range (fct_engine_failures): the failure mode of its work order, the time in service and cycles flown since the previous return to service (empty when that began before the CDC history), the time to return to service (empty while still down) and the downtime the work order recorded. Newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    engine_id AS `Engine`,
    lifecycle_id AS `Lifecycle`,
    failed_at AS `Failed at`,
    failure_cycle AS `Cycle`,
    failure_mode AS `Failure mode`,
    operating_seconds AS `In service before`,
    operating_cycles AS `Cycles flown`,
    repair_seconds AS `Time to repair`,
    returned_to_service_at AS `Back in service`,
    work_order_downtime_seconds AS `Work-order downtime`
FROM fct_engine_failures FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(failed_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY failed_at DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Time in status per lifecycle
panels.description: Every lifecycle of the selected engines that overlaps the range (fct_engine_lifecycle_status_time): time in each status, availability and failures. A lifecycle is keyed by the registry's lifecycle when an interval began: its repair belongs to the lifecycle that failed, the reset to the one it starts. To is empty for the running lifecycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    engine_id AS `Engine`,
    lifecycle_id AS `Lifecycle`,
    observed_from AS `From`,
    if(is_current = 1, NULL, observed_to) AS `To`,
    healthy_seconds AS `Healthy`,
    warning_seconds AS `Warning`,
    critical_seconds AS `Critical`,
    failure_seconds AS `In repair`,
    maintenance_reset_seconds AS `Reset`,
    availability AS `Availability`,
    failures AS `Failures`
FROM fct_engine_lifecycle_status_time FINAL
WHERE observed_from <= $__toTime
  AND observed_to >= $__fromTime
  AND $__conditionalAll(engine_id IN (${engine_id:singlequote}), $engine_id)
ORDER BY observed_from DESC, engine_id
LIMIT 500

list.definition:
-- engines that are registered and not deleted (current CDC state of the registry)
SELECT engine_id
FROM raw_engine_status_registry
GROUP BY engine_id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, cdc_lsn) = 0
ORDER BY engine_id
list.description: Engines currently in the registry (raw_engine_status_registry, latest CDC version per engine).
list.label: Engine
list.name: engine_id

query.rawSql:
-- engines that are registered and not deleted (current CDC state of the registry)
SELECT engine_id
FROM raw_engine_status_registry
GROUP BY engine_id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, cdc_lsn) = 0
ORDER BY engine_id
